The '''Boro-borosa system''' was located In the [[Senex-Juvex/Legends|Senex-Juvex's]] [[Senex sector/Legends|Senex sector]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEA" /> and [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]]<ref name="Western Reaches" /> regions of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], just off of the [[Anturi Reach]], and was connected to the [[Atron system/Legends|Atron system]] by a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was composed of three different [[Star/Legends|suns]], which seemed to give its [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Boro-borosa III]], its dry [[Desert/Legends|desert]] terrain.<ref name="TEA" />
